description_en: Revokes the authorization for a virtual private cloud (VPC) or a virtual border router (VBR) to access an Express Connect Router (ECR) owned by another account
description_zh: 撤销专有网络（VPC）或者边界路由器（VBR）对跨账号的专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）的授权
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter revoke-instance-from-express-connect-router --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --ecr-owner-ali-uid 1210123456120000 --instance-id vbr-j6cwxhgg0s5nuephp0000 --instance-type VBR --instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: RevokeInstanceFromExpressConnectRouter

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ECR instance
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the ECR instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 撤销授权的ECR实例所属阿里云账号（主账号）ID
parameters.name: ecr_owner_ali_uid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the network instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VBR: a VBR instance.

VPC: a VPC instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：
VBR：边界路由器实例。
VPC：专有网络实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the network instance whose authorization you want to revoke
parameters.help_zh: 撤销授权的网络实例所在的地域
parameters.name: instance_region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Sends a check request without modifying service resources.

false (default): Sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client for each request. The \`ClientToken\` parameter supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

Code.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A return value of 200 indicates that the call was successful. Other return values indicate a failure. For more information about the cause of the failure, see the Error codes section
Code.description_zh: 判断调用是否成功。返回值为 200 表示加载成功，返回其他值表示加载失败，失败原因参见错误码

DynamicMessage.description_en:
The dynamic error message that is used to replace the `%s` placeholder in the ErrMessage parameter.

For example, if the value of ErrMessage is The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid and the value of DynamicMessage is DtsJobId, it indicates that the specified DtsJobId parameter is invalid
DynamicMessage.description_zh:
动态错误信息，用于替换返回参数ErrMessage错误信息中的`%s`。

如果ErrMessage返回The Value of Input Parameter %s is not valid，且DynamicMessage返回DtsJobId，则代表所传入的请求参数DtsJobId不合法
DynamicMessage.example: The param format of EcrId **** is illegal.

Message.description_en: The message returned for the operation

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the authorization was successfully revoked. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
撤销授权网络实例是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
